newsitem.title: USA: Information Storage sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Information Storage sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Information Storage Devices Inc said it expects to report a third quarter loss of aout $0.30 a share on revenue of around $7.5 million.
In the year ago quarter, the company earned $0.19 a share on revenue of $15.5 million.
Analysts had expected the company to report a profit of $0.04 a share, according to First Call.
In a statement, Information Storage Devices said it is experiencing continued softness in demand for its ChipCorder integrated circuit products for voice recording and playback.
Information Storage Devices said the softness is coming principally from accounts that use ChipCorder in consumer-oriented products.
Also, a recent unexpected delay on delivery on orders, or a so-called "stretch-out", by a major customer also contributed to the earnings shortfall.
The company estimates its book value will add up to about $7.50 a share at the third quarter's end, including cash and marketable securities of roughly $6.00 per share.
The company expects to report third quarter financial results on or about Oct. 10, 1996.
